title: 🎬 Help Shape the Future of Sundance! 🌍

commenti.body:
Not to crap on your idea. And I hope you find the support you are looking for.

But personally, I already think Sundance has lost much of its identity from its inception in the 1980s and by pushing for a more global festival would further miss the point.

Sundance was created to help burgeoning voices in the American film community. Thats why it is not specifically an international film festival but one aimed for smaller artists.

Over the years, Sundance has gotten bigger and bigger while slowly divorcing itself from that original idea. Now major filmmakers with huge actors play consistently. It has kinda lost its independent American roots.

We have lots of international film festivals, but few that actually cater to the smaller voices in film. I'd prefer to keep it that way.
